EPA 2 DOPS obese row (p29): 'Minimum 4 of specified DOPS' but only 3 items are listed (mask/bag ventilation, ETT, plus DLT on p30). Template adds 'LMA insertion' in obese patient (R2-DOPS-02), which the guidebook does not list.
EPA 2 DOPS R1 row deadline is 'first 2 months of R1' (byYear set to 1).
EPA 3 (p43): Mini-CEX number cell reads 'Minimum 1 by end R2)' with a stray closing parenthesis; kept verbatim.
EPA 3 (p44-45): four separate Case Log rows (peripheral nerve blocks, subarachnoid blocks, epidural/caudal, PNB with catheter); each recorded as its own assessment row.

EPA 3: 'Management of patient undergoing surgery with a peripheral nerve block catheter' appears twice as EBD (by end R3 for level 3; by end R5 for level 4), matching template R3-EBD-13 and R5-EBD-01.
EPA 4 (p51): EBD number says 'Minimum 1 by R5' (not 'by end R5'); spec says 'To be completed by end R5'.

EPA 5 (p60): only one supervision level given (Level 4 by end R3); no Mini-CEX or DOPS. Case Log number cell lists bare '4' and '8' matched to 'by end R3'/'by end R5' in the adjacent cell (byYear null). Experiences row (p59-60) also mentions 'at least 4 cases over 3 years' and 'Minimum 8 case logs by end R5'.
EPA 6 (p68): Mini-CEX deadline cell says 'To be completed by R3' (no 'end').

EPA 7 (p81-82): main EPA's Mini-CEX/DOPS/EBD rows have no items of their own; they point to EPA 7a/7b ('Please refer'). Counts there (DOPS min 3, EBD min 3 = 1 by R3 + 2 by R5) are the sums over 7a/7b.
EPA 7a (p85): EBD R3 lists 5 alternative scenarios with 'Minimum 1'; the template collapses them into one item (R3-EBD-01).
EPA 7a (p85) Case Logs spec numbers its two entries '1. 10 direct supervision of labour epidural' (level 3, by end R3) and '2. Minimum 40' (level 4, no explicit deadline).
EPA 7b limitations: 'In addition to those mentioned under limitations of main EPA 7, this EPA excludes the following:' ; the first list entry is that qualifier, not an item.

EPA 8 (p98): EBD number cell has an unbalanced parenthesis: 'Minimum 2 (At most only 1 paediatric patient may be discussed) 1 by end R3 for level 3 supervision 1 by end R5 for level 4 supervision)'; kept verbatim. Items 'MRI suite' and 'Interventional radiology suite' are bullets.

EPA 9 (p106): Mini-CEX number says 'Minimum 2 by end R3 for level 3 supervision' but the first item (GA/ SR case) is 'To be completed by end R2'. Case Log breakdown includes '< 3 months 5 cases', which falls outside the EPA's own limitation (excludes children < 3 years); recorded verbatim.

EPA 10 (p112-113): Central venous catheter insertion is a DOPS (min 3 by end R2) in the guidebook but appears as 3 Mini-CEX items in the tracking template (R2-MiniCEX-01..03). Only one supervision level: Level 3 at end R5 (exit at level 3, subspecialty).
EPA 12 (p124): 'Which supervision level' says Level 3 by end R5, yet Mini-CEX and EBD are both 'by end R3 for level 3 supervision'. No Competency Evaluation or Case Log row.
EPA 12 Mini-CEX/EBD items use a numbered heading followed by a bullet sub-point (e.g. '1. Assessing chronic pain' / '• History and physical examination'); joined as one item with ' • '.
Template R3-DOPS-01 says 'transabdominal plane block'; guidebook EPA 3 says 'Transversus abdominis plane block'.
Bulleted sub-lists inside a numbered item are kept joined with ' • ' (e.g. EPA 3 lower-limb and truncal DOPS).

byYear/forLevel are parsed from the 'number' cell; where that cell has no year but the specifications cell gives a single 'To be completed by end Rx' (e.g. EPA 4 Competency Evaluation and Case Logs, case reflections in EPAs 5/7/7a/7b/8/11, EPA 12 MSF), byYear was taken from the specifications cell. Rows with several deadlines have byYear null plus byYearAll; per-deadline detail is in itemGroups[].completeBy.
R3-EBD-01 (template) is treated as covering all five EPA 7a EBD R3 alternatives, so none of them is listed as unmatched.
